caseName: Bowman Biltmore Hotels Corp. v. Roberts
caseNameFull: Bowman Biltmore Hotels Corp. v. Roberts, Receiver
attorneys: Messrs. Wm. H. Page, Richard M. Page, Frank C. Laughlin, Spotswood D. Bowers, and Jos. F. Mulqueen, Jr., for petitioners. Messrs. Carl M. Owen, Charles E. Hughes, Jr., Charles Franklin, George Welwood Murray, Harold C. McCollom, Martin A. Schenck, and Paxton Blair for respondents.
